The edge of the spine where the rings attach shows irregular, wavy geometry that suggests the material is losing cohesion, typical of AI generation struggles with hard mechanical edges.
The line where the blue wall meets the shelf/background objects is wavy and inconsistent, indicating weak geometric grounding in the background.

The hand-drawn cartoon lines vary inconsistently in opacity and integration with the cover texture, appearing slightly 'painted on' rather than physically drawn, though less severe than the structural issues.
